messages:
Amelia K: Heads up @channel — during yesterday's KMS migration for a sandbox project we found a small batch of service account keys exported in a migration artifact. No public disclosure detected, but these keys are privileged and used by some infra automation. Immediate actions required from owners.

Amelia K: TL;DR: rotate affected service account keys, revoke old keys, confirm via this thread by EOD PT. Security team has created a denylist and scoped temporary network controls.

security-oncall: Automated detection flagged 7 keys across 3 projects. We have disabled 2 sessions and triggered a targeted revoke for one key that was active. Full list (internal only) sent to relevant owners via DM.

Devon L: Which projects? Are Dedicated infra pools impacted? We run several cron jobs with SA keys.

Amelia K: Devon — projects: sandbox-dataflow, infra-tooling, and ci-mirror. Only ci-mirror had any external egress. Dedicated production pools not listed, but please run a quick audit: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=<sa>` and check `lastUsed` fields.

Michelle Z: Putting a small script here for rotation (works for GCP):

```
for SA in $(cat affected_sas.txt); do
  gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-key.json --iam-account=$SA
  cat new-key.json | vault write secret/sa-keys/$SA - # example
  gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete $OLD_KEY_ID --iam-account=$SA
done
```

Michelle Z: Replace with your KMS/HSM upload steps if needed. Ensure you update any CI secrets and redeploy jobs referencing keys.

ops-lead: Will coordinate with platform teams to schedule quick rollouts. Recommend a 2-hour maintenance window per team to update secrets and restart relevant services.

Raj P: Security note: if you can't rotate immediately, revoke any tokens and apply short-term IAM conditions (time-bound). Also remove `roles/iam.serviceAccountKeyAdmin` from any non-admin identities that had it during migration.

Devon L: Affected infra jobs are low-risk, we'll rotate and restart now. Will post confirmations.

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4822 and scheduled an automated key-rotation run at 23:00 UTC. Link: https://redwood.internal/t/INFRA-4822

security-oncall: Reminder checklist: 1) rotate keys 2) revoke old keys 3) update CI secrets 4) confirm in thread with screenshot of `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list` showing only new keys 5) run `rbac-scan` (link in DM)

Amelia K: If your team needs help, ping @security-oncall or @Michelle Z. We'll do a follow-up org-wide summary tomorrow with root cause and mitigations.

Devon L: Confirmed — rotated keys for infra-tooling and ci-mirror, restarted services. Screenshot attached in DM. :white_check_mark:

Raj P: Done for sandbox-dataflow. Removed elevated role from temp accounts. :lock:

ops-lead: Ops status: we applied network ACLs to reduce egress risk while rotations occur. No customer-facing impact.

Amelia K: Thanks everyone. We'll keep this thread as the authoritative record. Expect a short postmortem and a new policy to require ephemeral credentials or KMS-backed keys for automation by Q3.

security-oncall: Closing automated alert after all confirmations received. If anyone finds anything else, reopen by tagging this thread.
